statement: The taker (not the maker) fills a whole ratio 1..65535 of what remains, while the offer is live in the judge's view. Each leg is floor(amount * ratio / 65535) on its own, the arithmetic of DeltaTransformer's applySwap, so a fill the chain would settle at the same ratio moves the same amounts. A fill that takes nothing of a leg is refused (fill_too_small): every fill is a trade. The whole fill (65535) drops the offer. The first fill of a quote is its acceptance (R-SWAP-CONSENT): the taker's want, in whole, is reserved against the taker only if its RCPAN still holds, and a remainder is a clause only if the Account has a clause to spare (too_many_holds). The Arrival cell holds the fill ratio and the arithmetic: a whole ratio of what remains, each leg floor(remainder * ratio / 65535) on its own, the legs filled never exceeding the legs offered, nothing created or lost on the offdeltas, a whole fill dropping the offer, and a first fill of a quote (its acceptance, R-SWAP-CONSENT) needing room for the taker's whole want; that only the taker fills, that a fill taking nothing of a leg is refused (fill_too_small) and that a fill is judged in the judge's view are guards on the page that no property or planted bug pins, and the 33rd clause of a first fill (too_many_holds) is on no page.
source: Arthur 10-01 02:53 (D3: two-party swap inside an Account); plan/swap-onchain.md; coordinator 10-01
